_comment: Attribute fixes: one Terraform attribute (or nested block attribute), changed in place, that cannot cut off traffic or permissions. Ops: set, at_least, one_of (value is the default pick), includes (list must contain every value). 'when' guards which resources a fix applies to; a null in 'in' means the attribute is absent. Account-scope fixes match the one resource of that type in state.

fixes.title: RDS DB instances should be configured with multiple Availability Zones
fixes.why: A standby in a second Availability Zone keeps the database up through a zone outage. The conversion runs online.

fixes.title: RDS clusters should have deletion protection enabled
fixes.why: Blocks deleting the cluster until someone turns protection off first. Reads and writes are unaffected.

fixes.title: RDS DB instances should have deletion protection enabled
fixes.why: Blocks deleting the instance until someone turns protection off first. Reads and writes are unaffected.

fixes.title: IAM authentication should be configured for RDS instances
fixes.why: Adds IAM tokens as a way to log in. Existing password logins keep working.

fixes.title: RDS instances should have automatic backups enabled
fixes.why: Keeps a week of automated backups and transaction logs, so the database can be restored to any point in that week.
fixes.note: If backups were off (retention 0), turning them on causes a brief I/O suspension (a short outage on Single-AZ instances). Merge in a quiet window. More backups add storage cost.

fixes.title: IAM authentication should be configured for RDS clusters
fixes.why: Adds IAM tokens as a way to log in. Existing password logins keep working.

fixes.title: RDS automatic minor version upgrades should be enabled
fixes.why: Minor engine patches install in the maintenance window you already have.

fixes.title: RDS automatic minor version upgrades should be enabled
fixes.why: Minor engine patches install in the maintenance window you already have.

fixes.title: RDS DB clusters should be configured to copy tags to snapshots
fixes.why: Snapshots inherit the cluster's tags, so ownership and cost tags follow the data.

fixes.title: RDS DB instances should be configured to copy tags to snapshots
fixes.why: Snapshots inherit the instance's tags, so ownership and cost tags follow the data.

fixes.title: Aurora MySQL DB clusters should publish audit logs to CloudWatch Logs
fixes.why: Sends the audit log to CloudWatch Logs so database activity is kept outside the cluster.
fixes.note: Audit events only appear once server_audit_logging is on in the cluster parameter group.

fixes.title: RDS for PostgreSQL DB instances should publish logs to CloudWatch Logs
fixes.why: Sends the PostgreSQL log to CloudWatch Logs so errors and connections are kept outside the instance.

fixes.title: Aurora PostgreSQL DB clusters should publish logs to CloudWatch Logs
fixes.why: Sends the PostgreSQL log to CloudWatch Logs so errors and connections are kept outside the cluster.

fixes.title: Amazon DocumentDB clusters should have an adequate backup retention period
fixes.why: Keeps a week of automated backups to restore from. Backups run without downtime.

fixes.title: Amazon DocumentDB clusters should publish audit logs to CloudWatch Logs
fixes.why: Sends the audit log to CloudWatch Logs so database activity is kept outside the cluster.
fixes.note: Audit events only appear once audit_logs is enabled in the cluster parameter group.

fixes.title: Amazon DocumentDB clusters should have deletion protection enabled
fixes.why: Blocks deleting the cluster until someone turns protection off first.

fixes.title: Neptune DB clusters should publish audit logs to CloudWatch Logs
fixes.why: Sends the audit log to CloudWatch Logs so graph queries are kept outside the cluster.
fixes.note: Audit events only appear once neptune_enable_audit_log is on in the cluster parameter group.

fixes.title: Neptune DB clusters should have deletion protection enabled
fixes.why: Blocks deleting the cluster until someone turns protection off first.

fixes.title: Neptune DB clusters should have automated backups enabled
fixes.why: Keeps a week of automated backups to restore from. Backups run without downtime.

fixes.title: Neptune DB clusters should have IAM database authentication enabled
fixes.why: Lets clients sign requests with IAM credentials instead of relying on the network alone.
fixes.note: Once on, unsigned requests are refused. Check clients sign requests (SigV4) before merging.

fixes.title: Neptune DB clusters should be configured to copy tags to snapshots
fixes.why: Snapshots inherit the cluster's tags, so ownership and cost tags follow the data.

fixes.title: DynamoDB tables should have point-in-time recovery enabled
fixes.why: Lets you restore the table to any second in the last 35 days. Reads and writes are unaffected.

fixes.title: DynamoDB tables should have deletion protection enabled
fixes.why: Blocks deleting the table until someone turns protection off first.

fixes.title: AWS KMS key rotation should be enabled
fixes.why: AWS rotates the key material every year. Old ciphertext still decrypts; key ids and aliases don't change.

fixes.title: Application load balancers should be configured to drop HTTP headers
fixes.why: Removes malformed headers before they reach your targets. The request itself still goes through.

fixes.title: Application Load Balancer deletion protection should be enabled
fixes.why: Blocks deleting the load balancer until someone turns protection off first.

fixes.title: Classic Load Balancers should have connection draining enabled
fixes.why: Lets in-flight requests finish before an instance leaves the load balancer.

fixes.title: Classic Load Balancers should have cross-zone load balancing enabled
fixes.why: Spreads requests across instances in every enabled zone, so one zone isn't overloaded.

fixes.title: Application Load Balancers should be configured with defensive or strictest desync mitigation mode
fixes.why: Defensive is the AWS default. It blocks request-smuggling patterns and lets normal traffic through.

fixes.title: Classic Load Balancers should be configured with defensive or strictest desync mitigation mode
fixes.why: Defensive is the AWS default. It blocks request-smuggling patterns and lets normal traffic through.

fixes.title: CloudTrail should be enabled and configured with at least one multi-Region trail
fixes.why: Records API activity in every Region, including global services like IAM, in the trail you already have.
fixes.note: More events means somewhat more S3 storage for the trail.

fixes.title: Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
fixes.why: Adds signed digest files so you can prove the logs weren't changed or deleted.

fixes.title: ECR private repositories should have image scanning configured
fixes.why: Scans each image for known vulnerabilities when it's pushed. Pushes and pulls are unaffected.

fixes.title: ECR private repositories should have tag immutability configured
fixes.why: A pushed tag can no longer be overwritten, so a deployed tag always means the same image. Pulls are unaffected.
fixes.note: Pipelines that re-push the same tag (like latest) will fail. Switch them to unique tags (commit SHA) before merging.

fixes.title: EKS clusters should have audit logging enabled
fixes.why: Sends the Kubernetes audit log to CloudWatch Logs. The control plane keeps serving while logging turns on.
fixes.note: Audit logs on busy clusters add CloudWatch Logs cost.

fixes.title: ElastiCache for Redis clusters should have automatic backups scheduled
fixes.why: Takes a daily snapshot you can restore from.

fixes.title: Minor version upgrades should be automatically applied to ElastiCache for Redis cache clusters
fixes.why: Minor engine patches install in the maintenance window you already have.

fixes.title: ElastiCache for Redis replication groups should have automatic failover enabled
fixes.why: If the primary node fails, a replica takes over automatically instead of waiting for a person.
fixes.note: Needs at least one replica; terraform plan fails without one, and PosturaNet stops. A failover drops open connections for a few seconds.

fixes.title: DMS replication instances should have automatic minor version upgrade enabled
fixes.why: Minor engine patches install in the maintenance window you already have.

fixes.title: Amazon Redshift clusters should have automatic snapshots enabled
fixes.why: Keeps a week of automated snapshots to restore from. Queries are unaffected.

fixes.title: Amazon Redshift should have automatic upgrades to major versions enabled
fixes.why: Lets engine upgrades install in the maintenance window you already have.

fixes.title: Amazon SQS queues should be encrypted at rest
fixes.why: SQS-managed encryption is transparent: producers and consumers need no new permissions.

fixes.title: API Gateway REST API stages should have AWS X-Ray tracing enabled
fixes.why: Traces sampled requests through the API. Responses are unchanged.

fixes.title: API Gateway REST API cache data should be encrypted at rest
fixes.why: Encrypts cached responses. Cache hits and misses behave the same.

fixes.title: Kinesis Data Streams should be encrypted at rest
fixes.why: Encrypts records with the AWS managed Kinesis key, which producers and consumers can already use.

fixes.title: Network Firewall firewalls should have deletion protection enabled
fixes.why: Blocks deleting the firewall until someone turns protection off first. Traffic inspection is unaffected.

fixes.title: Athena workgroups should be encrypted at rest
fixes.why: Encrypts query results with S3-managed keys. Queries and readers need no new permissions.

fixes.title: EBS default encryption should be enabled
fixes.why: New volumes in this Region are encrypted by default. Existing volumes don't change.

fixes.title: EC2 instances should use IMDSv2
fixes.why: Requires session tokens for the instance metadata service, which blocks SSRF-style credential theft. The instance keeps running.
fixes.note: Software on the instance that still uses IMDSv1 (very old AWS SDKs or CLI, custom curl scripts) loses access to instance credentials. Check the MetadataNoToken CloudWatch metric is 0 before merging.

fixes.title: EC2 subnets should not automatically assign public IP addresses
fixes.why: New instances in this subnet stop getting a public IP by default. Running instances keep theirs.
fixes.note: Instances launched later in this subnet won't be reachable from the internet unless they ask for a public IP. If this is a public subnet by design, set the IP on the launch template instead.

fixes.title: EC2 Transit Gateways should not automatically accept VPC attachment requests
fixes.why: New attachment requests from shared accounts wait for approval. Existing attachments keep working.
fixes.note: Someone has to accept each new cross-account attachment from now on.

fixes.title: S3 general purpose buckets should have versioning enabled
fixes.why: Keeps earlier versions of overwritten or deleted objects so they can be restored.
fixes.note: Old versions add storage cost; a lifecycle rule can expire them.

fixes.title: S3 general purpose buckets should have versioning enabled
fixes.why: Keeps earlier versions of overwritten or deleted objects so they can be restored.
fixes.note: Old versions add storage cost; a lifecycle rule can expire them.

fixes.title: MSK clusters should have enhanced monitoring configured
fixes.why: Publishes per-broker metrics to CloudWatch. Producers and consumers are unaffected.
fixes.note: Enhanced metrics are billed by CloudWatch.

fixes.title: GuardDuty should be enabled
fixes.why: Turns threat detection back on for the detector you already manage. It reads logs and changes nothing.
fixes.note: GuardDuty is billed by the volume of logs it analyzes.

fixes.title: AWS Config should be enabled
fixes.why: Restarts the configuration recorder you already manage. It records changes and changes nothing.
fixes.note: Config is billed per recorded configuration item.

fixes.title: Amazon Macie should be enabled
fixes.why: Turns Macie back on for the account. It inventories S3 buckets and changes nothing.
fixes.note: Macie bills for bucket monitoring and any discovery jobs you run.

fixes.title: Password policies for IAM users should have strong configurations
fixes.why: Applies at each user's next password change. Current passwords and access keys keep working.

fixes.title: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum password length of 14 or greater
fixes.why: Applies at each user's next password change. Current passwords and access keys keep working.

fixes.title: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
fixes.why: Applies at each user's next password change. Current passwords and access keys keep working.

fixes.title: CodeBuild S3 logs should be encrypted
fixes.why: Encrypts the build logs CodeBuild already writes to S3. Builds run the same.
